description: This file defines a sealed class 'ExactMatchChannelNamespacePredicate' that implements the 'IChannelNamespacePredicate' interface. It provides functionality to match a stream namespace exactly, with a constructor to initialize the target namespace and methods to generate a predicate pattern and check for a match.

classes.name: ExactMatchChannelNamespacePredicate
classes.description: A predicate class that matches stream namespaces exactly based on a specified target namespace.

methods.name: ExactMatchChannelNamespacePredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the predicate with a target stream namespace.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Property that returns the pattern string for the predicate, combining a prefix with the target namespace.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Method that checks if a given stream namespace matches the target namespace exactly.
